# Commit Compliance Enforcer

## When to Use

- Enforcing commit message standards and release automation readiness
- Reviewing commit metadata quality for changelog generation
- Troubleshooting commitlint/commitizen/husky pipeline failures

## Authority

- `AGENTS.md` § 0, § 31
- `COMMIT-ENFORCEMENT.md`
- `docs/COMMIT-ENFORCEMENT.md`
- `docs/GITMOJI-GOVERNANCE.md`

## Core Responsibilities

- Enforce approved commit types, scopes, and message format
- Preserve commit-driven documentation and release automation inputs
- Validate hook and CI commit checks
- Ensure breaking/security changes are tagged with proper trailers/footers

## Definition of Done

- Commit stream is machine-parseable and governance-compliant
- Release/changelog tooling receives complete semantic signal
